title: University of Pennsylvania Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Penn meets 100% of demonstrated need for the international students it admits each year, with grant-only packages (no loans).

  • Grant and work-study aid meeting 100% of demonstrated need
  • No loans

Eligibility: International applicants (need-aware) who request aid at the same time as applying for admission.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Pedro Arrupe, S.J., Scholarship for Peace at Georgetown University
description:
One of Georgetown’s very limited need-based scholarships for international first-years, for students with need seeking a Jesuit education.

  • Need-based scholarship

Eligibility: Selected international first-year applicants (not SCS) with financial need; transfers are not eligible.

How to apply: Apply for aid together with your admission application (CSS Profile or the college’s own form); you cannot apply later. Regular Decision deadlines fall in early January (Early Decision in November); check the admissions site for 2027 dates.

title: Tulane University Merit Scholarships for International Students
description:
Merit scholarships for international students at Tulane, up to full tuition or the full cost of attendance.

  • Partial merit scholarships for all applicants
  • Competitive awards up to full tuition or full cost of attendance
  • Need-based aid up to about USD 30,000 for some students

Eligibility: International first-year applicants; all are considered for partial merit through the Common Application.

How to apply: Apply through the Common Application; special scholarships may have earlier deadlines.

title: Wake Forest University Merit Scholarships for International Students
description:
International students are eligible for most Wake Forest merit scholarships, including full-cost awards such as the Carswell, Gordon, Reynolds and Stamps.

  • Merit scholarships up to the full cost of attendance

Eligibility: International first-year applicants (no need-based aid for foreign nationals; not for transfers).

How to apply: Your admission application is your scholarship application; apply early for full-cost award consideration.

title: Boston University Trustee Scholarship
description:
BU’s most prestigious merit award, covering full tuition, open to international students.

  • Full tuition for four years

Eligibility: Outstanding first-year applicants, including international students.

How to apply: Apply for admission by 1 December 2026 with the Trustee Scholarship essay.

title: Boston University Presidential Scholarship
description:
A half-tuition merit scholarship at Boston University that international students can receive.

  • Half tuition for four years

Eligibility: High-achieving first-year applicants, including international students.

How to apply: Apply for admission by 1 December 2026 to be considered.

title: Université de Montréal Tuition Exemption Scholarship for International Students
description:
UdeM’s exemption scholarship cuts the supplemental tuition fees paid by international students, assessed automatically at admission.

  • Partial or total exemption from supplemental international fees
  • At PhD level, students pay the same tuition as Québec students

Eligibility: Eligible international students with valid CAQ and study permit, enrolled full time without interruption, with no other exemption.

How to apply: No separate request: eligible files are assessed when you apply for admission.

title: Université Laval Tuition Exemption Scholarships for International Students
description:
Québec-funded exemptions from supplemental tuition for outstanding international students at Laval, including priority-sector French programmes and doctoral studies.

  • Exemption from supplemental international tuition

Eligibility: Outstanding international students in eligible French-language programmes, and admitted doctoral students with a valid study permit (French and Belgian students already have exemptions).

How to apply: Doctoral applications are due 31 August (summer), 31 December (fall) or 30 April (winter); other exemptions follow the admission cycle.

title: Waseda University Partial Tuition-Waiver Scholarship for International Students
description:
A partial tuition waiver for privately financed international students at Waseda University in Tokyo.

  • Waiver of up to 50% of annual tuition (or one semester) for one year

Eligibility: Privately financed international students with “College Student” status (not MEXT or government-sponsored).

How to apply: Apply through Waseda’s scholarship system; awards are competitive.

title: Waseda University Azusa Ono Memorial Scholarship
description:
A one-year grant for privately financed international students at Waseda.

  • JPY 300,000-400,000 for one year

Eligibility: Privately financed international students at Waseda.

How to apply: Apply through Waseda’s scholarship system.

title: Keio University “Design the Future” Award
description:

  • Monthly living stipend
  • One-time admission payment

Eligibility: International applicants to Keio undergraduate programmes.

How to apply: Apply with your Keio admission application.

title: Keio University Scholarship for International Students
description:

  • JPY 500,000-600,000 a year (graduate)
  • Degree Completion Scholarship up to tuition (about 100 awards)

Eligibility: Privately financed international students enrolled at Keio.

How to apply: Apply through Keio’s student scholarship system.

title: Peking University Scholarship for International Students (PKUS)
description:
Peking University’s own scholarship (since 2012) for outstanding international bachelor’s, master’s and PhD students.

  • Living stipend
  • Medical insurance
  • 4 years (bachelor’s/PhD) or 2-3 years (master’s)

Eligibility: International applicants not holding other scholarships.

How to apply: One online application on studyatpku.com covers PKUS, the Chinese Government and Beijing Government scholarships; the 2026 deadline was 9 March.

description:

Eligibility: Postgraduate applicants with a firm offer of admission, selected on academic merit; undergraduate international students are not eligible.

How to apply: No application needed: students with a firm offer are considered automatically.

title: University of Johannesburg International Student Fund
description:

Eligibility: International students on their first higher education qualification who passed at least half their modules with distinctions.

How to apply: Check UJ’s Division for Global Engagement for the current call.

  • Paid research role

Eligibility: Applicants with a First or Upper Second Class honours degree in a related field.

How to apply: Check the iLabAfrica page for the current call.

title: IIUM Postgraduate Ummatic Scholarship
description:

  • RM 1,000 monthly stipend for up to three years

Eligibility: PhD applicants aged 30 or under with a CGPA of 3.70 in both bachelor’s and master’s, a strong publication record and IELTS/TOEFL.

How to apply: The 2026 round closed on 15 July 2026; the next round is expected on a similar timeline.

Eligibility: International students with an admission offer, a high school average of at least 95% and IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 80.

How to apply: Apply for the scholarship after receiving your admission offer.

title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarship at Liverpool Hope University
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission / Liverpool Hope University
description:

  • Stipend of £1,712 a month (£2,000 in London)
  • Return airfare to the UK
  • Thesis and study travel grants
  • Courses in the 2026 programme: MA Disability Studies; MSc Public Health

Eligibility: Citizens of Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, the Maldives, Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Zambia, Malawi, Mozambique, South Africa, Sierra Leone, The Gambia and other eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries who cannot afford UK study without the award and have a first degree (usually upper second or better). You must also secure admission to the course.

How to apply: Applications for 2027/28 open on 10 November 2026 and close at 16:00 GMT on 8 December 2026 via the CSC online system; the 2027 course list is published before opening.
